content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Young Professional-I posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-I posts at ICAR CRRI is scheduled for 15th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture (Soil Science, Agronomy, or Agricultural Microbiology) or a B.Sc. (Hons.) in Botany, Microbiology, Environmental Science, Biotechnology, or Chemistry to be eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I role?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional-I position is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-I post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Young Professional-I position at ICAR CRRI?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date with all original and photocopied documents.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry one recent passport-size photograph, original educational certificates from matriculation onwards, Xerox copies of these certificates, and experience certificates of the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Young Professional-I posts?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve a screening test if there is a large number of candidates, followed by a written-cum-personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICAR CRRI located?
faq.answer: ICAR CRRI is located in Kataka, Odisha, with the pincode 753006.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Young Professional-I position is a project-based role within the research field at ICAR CRRI.
